scope: Primary-source survey for future Neuve PR Bench. Research observations and proposals, not adopted evaluation policy.
verification: Publisher claims are identified separately from artifact checks. No model evaluation was reproduced. GitHub and Hugging Face revision IDs were read through public APIs.

entries.name: CodeReviewer
entries.input: Local diff for quality estimation/comment generation; code plus review comment for refinement. Nine languages are corpus coverage, not Neuve eligibility rules.
entries.oracle: Mined review activity and reference human comments/edits; classification, BLEU/exact match and human study depending on task.
entries.availability_license: Model, scripts, dataset download pointers public; CodeBERT repository MIT. Data redistribution terms require separate verification.
limits: Local text similarity does not establish defect correctness or complete PR review.
Old public OSS data creates contamination and near-duplicate risks.
A human comment is an observed action, not exhaustive truth.
reuse: Separate quality estimation, comment generation, and contributor revision tasks.

entries.name: CR-Bench / CR-Bench-Verified
entries.publication: 2026-03-10 preprint; ICLR 2026 Agents in the Wild workshop paper
entries.input: Original defect-introducing PR and base repository recovered by blame from a SWE-bench fixing patch.
entries.oracle: Later issue description paraphrased into defect reference, with LLM detectability filter; verified subset manually checked. Claude Sonnet 4.5 classifies bug hit, valid suggestion, or noise.
entries.availability_license: Paper and prompts public. No dataset/harness download and corresponding data license confirmed in inspected primary sources. Paper CC BY 4.0 is not a dataset license.
limits: Retrospective bug selection is not naturally observed review feedback.
Known defects are explicitly incomplete.
Blame attribution can confuse introduction with later edits; requires case audit.
SWE-bench overlap and future fixes require temporal isolation.
reuse: Measure useful additional suggestions separately from incorrect or irrelevant findings.

entries.name: Code Review Bench
entries.input: Frozen forked PRs for offline tools; fresh bot-reviewed PR timelines and later contributor commits for online observational analysis.
entries.oracle: Offline human-curated golden comments with category profiles and three judge models; online match between bot suggestions and subsequent fixes.
entries.availability_license: Public dataset, prompts, pipeline and per-judge outputs; repository MIT, upstream content licenses remain relevant.
limits: Offline references are public and small.
Online accepted fixes do not prove correctness, causality, or exhaustive recall.
Freshness reduces contamination but is not proof of no training exposure.
Scoring profile, judge, deduplication and F-beta must be pinned.
reuse: Publish extracted findings, duplicate groups, judge prompts, and per-judge scores.
Retain observational acceptance separately from independently validated correctness.

entries.name: CodeReviewBench

artifact_check.method: Parsed JSON mapping; counted keys and array entries.

entries.input: Frozen repository tool-response replay inside Kodus review agent.
entries.oracle: Human-authored golden findings matched by Claude Haiku 4.5; micro precision, recall and F1.
entries.availability_license: Public goldens, submissions, scorecards and scripts. No explicit repository license detected through GitHub API or root listing.
limits: One review-generation run per model; judge reruns do not measure agent run variance.
30 PR sampling intervals overlap.
Existing leaderboard compares models within one vendor harness.
Same five repository families as Martian; independence must not be assumed.
reuse: Frozen tool replay, versioned submissions and paired uncertainty estimates.

entries.name: SWE-PRBench
entries.input: Frozen config_A/B/C contexts with increasing semantic layers, approximate budgets 2000/2200/2500 tokens; base and head SHA retained.
entries.oracle: Mined human review comments and GPT-5.2 judge; reported kappa 0.75 on validation subset.
entries.availability_license: Public contexts and annotations; HF data CC BY 4.0 and harness MIT.
entries.reported_result: Eight-model paper run reports lower scores for B/C than A. Not independently reproduced here.
limits: Config C is bounded generated context, not complete live repository investigation.
Changed layers, summaries, allocation and budgets confound a universal causal claim about attention.
Human comment absence is not proof that a new finding is false.
Merged-only, substantive-comment filters introduce selection bias.
reuse: Freeze context variants and record allocation losses; evaluate retrieval separately from downstream review.

entries.name: ContextCRBench
entries.publisher: Hu et al.; HIT Shenzhen / ByteDance
entries.input: Hunk-level quality estimation (67,910 entries); line-level defect localization and review comment generation (13,512 entries each), with linked issue/PR text and before/after function or class context.
entries.oracle: Mined review comment/line; quality classification, top-k localization, ROUGE and edit similarity for generated comments.
entries.availability_license: Public scripts and Google Drive links for 1.56 GB data / 6.16 GB raw data. Bulk downloads not tested; no explicit repository/data license confirmed. Paper license does not cover dataset automatically.
entries.reported_result: Paper reports textual-context benefit and industrial relative improvement; neither reproduced here.
limits: Label and filtering choices can remove difficult historical/outdated anchors relevant to Neuve.
Similarity/localization does not prove semantic correctness.
Subset evaluation is not an evaluation of all 67,910 entries.
Related issue descriptions and before/after versions need timestamp isolation.
reuse: Separate review need, precise attribution and explanation tasks; preserve historical anchors rather than discard outdated comments.

entries.name: SWE-CARE / CodeFuse-CR-Bench
entries.input: Problem statement, exact commit to review, base/merged patches and comments, plus none/BM25/oracle/all file-context conditions.
entries.oracle: Human review references with rule/location matching and model judges; original paper manually curated instances.
entries.availability_license: Public data and pipeline Apache-2.0. Underlying source content retains its own terms.
limits: Original paper selects Python projects; corpus coverage must not define Neuve language scope.
Oracle files use future merged changes and are an upper-bound experiment, not deployable retrieval.
Reward data positive/negative heuristic uses changed lines plus resolved threads; those are not disposition truth.
Original filters remove images/external references, losing UI and documentary context.
reuse: Compare BM25 against graph-backed evidence at equal input budgets; separate oracle condition.

entries.name: SWRBench / SWR-Bench
entries.input: Solver case is the PR state immediately before its first manual review: title, description, pr_commits before that cutoff, base/codebase checkpoint and repository context. Released pr_timeline and all_commits retain construction/history evidence; they are not unrestricted solver inputs.
entries.oracle: Manually verified structured change points with LLM-assisted extraction and judge matching; functional/evolvability categories.
entries.availability_license: Public JSONL, construction and evaluation code; MIT repository.
entries.reported_result: Paper reports approximately 90% judge/human agreement; not independently validated here.
limits: Clean labels establish no retained issue, not proof of complete defect absence.
Released pr_timeline and all_commits can expose future-answer fields if reused as solver context; preserve the paper first-manual-review cutoff and keep label/history fields outside that input.
Python-only source projects and balanced prevalence differ from deployment.
A requested design change need not be a functional bug.
reuse: Include clean-labeled controls and report PR-level abstention independently from per-finding precision.

entries.name: MCR-Bench

artifact_check.method: Downloaded pinned raw JSONL files and parsed each nonblank physical line with Python json.loads; no repair.

entries.input: Round-specific diffs, PR intent, linked issues and events_up_to_round.
entries.oracle: Defect cards with new/open/resolved/reopened state, LLM extraction/linking repeated three times plus reported manual cross-checking; model judge.
entries.availability_license: Public construction/evaluation code and data; repository Apache-2.0.
limits: Actual JS release fails strict JSONL parsing; reported task count not independently confirmed.
Tasks are round instances, not necessarily distinct PRs.
Annotation uses complete future history; solver inputs must use a strict cutoff.
Merged-only and latent-bug exclusions remove important failed-review/regression cases.
State accuracy is conditioned on correctly detected defects.
reuse: Evaluate historical attribution and unresolved-obligation continuity across revisions; retain round-to-PR identity without equating external rounds to Neuve review cycles.

entries.name: c-CRAB / Code Review Agent Benchmark
entries.input: SWE-CARE-derived review task in per-case executable environment; generated review guides a coding agent that attempts a correction.
entries.oracle: Human-comment-derived tests must fail before and pass after original fix, then be solvable by a coding agent guided by reference comment; final score tests the guided correction.
entries.availability_license: Public data, funnel, outputs, scripts; no explicit repository license detected. Upstream SWE-CARE Apache-2.0 does not settle new artifact rights.
limits: Final outcome combines reviewer and fixer capability.
Testability/solvability filters bias selection; most retained tests are structural.
Paper stage-3 table says 481 comments, release README says 485; paper repository count is internally inconsistent (67 table, 56 threats section).
184 final validated cases must not be confused with 410 filtered released rows.
reuse: Retain fail-before/pass-after evidence and independent correction reproduction for objectively testable findings.

entries.name: SWE-bench Verified
entries.input: Pre-fix repository and issue description; solver writes patch.
entries.oracle: Fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass test suites in reproducible environment.
entries.availability_license: Public data, images and MIT evaluation harness. HF card/API does not specify dataset license; upstream task licenses require inspection.
limits: Patch-generation success is not review quality.
OpenAI reports 59.4% material issues among targeted 138 difficult tasks, not 59.4% of all 500.
Public exposure and reproduced gold-patch details provide contamination evidence for some cases.
Tests can enforce unstated implementation details.
reuse: Reuse environment/log discipline and oracle sanity checks, not leaderboard scores as a review measure.

entries.name: SWE-bench Multimodal and SWE-bench Pro
entries.publisher: SWE-bench team; separately Scale AI for Pro
entries.publication: Multimodal preprint 2024-10-04, ICLR 2025; V2 2026-09-01. Pro preprint 2025-09-21; V2 2026-09-22.
entries.input: Multimodal issue text/image assets and repository; Pro long-horizon task requirements/interfaces and base repository. Both request patches.
entries.oracle: Executable issue-resolution tests; V2 releases report stronger environment/verification controls.
entries.availability_license: Public current data and tooling; harnesses MIT. Pro card explicitly retains upstream task licenses. Multimodal HF card/API license unspecified.
limits: Original Multimodal body reports 619 total = 517 test + 102 dev, but abstract says 617. Site original 517 is test scope; preserve abstract/body discrepancy.
OpenAI July 2026 audit estimates about 30% broken Pro v1 tasks, with 200 agent-audited/249 human-labeled tasks among 731; not a validation of later V2.
Public tests/reference patches require answer-access isolation.
Passing visual-domain tests does not validate UI design judgment.
reuse: UI cases must retain image references and captured rendering evidence.
Pin release and environment digest; audit test/prompt alignment and empty/reference patch controls.
